calculation.expression: prod(1 + r_i - beta_i*r_benchmark) - 1 over trailing 40 sessions, lagged one completed day
calculation.description: Estimate each tradable instrument's rolling 40-session beta to the equal-weight mean return of the 15 tradable assets, compound the residual returns, and lag the signal one session before use.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across 2020-22, 2023-24, and 2025-26 in the full validation output, but recent 2026-07-16 through 2027-02-24 performance was weak for the previously tested implementation; retain drift monitoring.
